dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: #Oh hey, if it isn't {NICKNAME}! If you're up for testing your marksmanship, what say you to giving this game a shot?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're from the Flower-Feather Clan?

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: That's right. I used to be a shooting instructor back in the tribe, had my hands full teaching folks about aerial marksmanship techniques.

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: And wouldn't you know it — many of my students went on to become real legends on the battlefield.

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: ...It's just a pity that their glorious achievements were the only things that ever came back...

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: As an instructor, I always longed to join my students on the battlefield, but the other tribespeople would never let me...

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: "Your skill in teaching is far more valuable than your marksmanship itself!"... That's the sort of stuff they would say, so I had to stay put for the sake of the tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: Of course, staying put didn't mean I just sat on my hands. I've been spending my days workshopping new ways to teach people how to shoot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you came here for more workshopping?

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: Well... Something like that! More accurately, I'm trying to find ways to get children interested in marksmanship.

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: Regular marksmanship training is hard and not particularly interesting — there's no sugarcoating it. Our warriors can push through with their willpower alone...

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: ...But it's a different story with kids. I'm just worried they won't have the patience to learn if learning isn't fun. If they run into too many hurdles, they might get turned off from the art of shooting altogether.

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: So, I wanted to create something that's fun, but also lets children pick up the basics of marksmanship.

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: Which brings me to the fruits of my workshopping! I guarantee as an instructor that it's interesting, thrilling, and most importantly, safe!

choices.text: So it's a game for kids?

response.speaker: Gaasira
response.text: Hahaha, don't give me that look! If you'd like, I can prepare a different, more age-appropriate set of challenges for you.

response.speaker: Gaasira
response.text: Right this way. Get on the stage, then get ready to take aim. I promise you're in for a good time.

choices.text: I might be a bit too old to find this challenging...

dialogues.speaker: Gaasira
dialogues.text: #How about it, {NICKNAME}? Up for a few rounds of shooting?

response.speaker: Gaasira
response.text: Sure thing. Get on the stage, then get ready to take aim. I promise you're in for a good time.

response.speaker: Gaasira
response.text: You go do what you need to do! If you want to give the game a try, just come find me.

dialogues.speaker: Pusaq
dialogues.text: Whoo! I think that's everything in order... Can't shake the feeling that something's missing, though...

dialogues.speaker: Pusaq
dialogues.text: #Well, hello, {NICKNAME}! You're just in time. Up for a game of graffiti spray?

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: Haha, there's no need to sound so nervous. It's just a game!

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: And in a game, no one gets hurt — at least not on my watch! I can't promise your clothes won't get a little messy, though.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm not very good when it comes to spraying graffiti...

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: Excuses, schmexcuses! C'mon, this game's good for even absolute rock-bottom beginners. Just start spraying and you'll have a blast!

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: The truth is, I was brought in to create something big, bold, and awe-inspiring to serve as a spray-painting subject...

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: Well, let's just say, while I did deliver something pretty epic, not everyone has the painting chops to do it justice.

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: So I did what any great artist would — I simplified the brief and placed more focus on the "process" of painting.

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: Simply put, I guess it's like... Hmm... Okay, I don't know how to put it simply. Let's just say, you'll understand once you try!

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: And by "try," I mean it's your turn to get out there and start making some art!

choices.text: Is this some sort of combat training?

dialogues.speaker: Pusaq
dialogues.text: Alright! Now all that's left is for everyone to enjoy their painting.

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: Haha, that's the spirit! Now it's your turn to get out there and start making some art. Have at it!

choices.text: I've got other things to do right now...

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: Take your time! Feel free to come back any time you want to play.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME}! Do you have a moment? I've got a story I want to share...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ooh, what's it about?

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: It's about traveling, friends, and family.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: In the People of the Springs, there was once a famous traveler by the name of Akamai.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: Together with his Koholasaurus companion, Kau Kau, he embarked on a long journey. Their quest: To traverse all of Natlan and feast on all its delicacies.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: Whenever they arrived somewhere new, Akamai and Kau Kau would search for the most beautiful stone around to keep as a memento.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: Their culinary journey brought them to countless places, filled their backpacks with innumerable beautiful stones, and stuffed their bellies with myriad delectable dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: Legend has it that by the time they made it back to the People of the Springs, Akamai was as portly as yours truly.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: But that's all by the by. The crux of this preamble is that the duo encountered many wonderful tales on their travels.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, if your ears are ready to listen, I'd be more than happy to share all these happenings with you!

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: I assure you, you won't regret taking the time to stop and listen!

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME}! Do you have a moment? I've got a story I want to share...

response.speaker: Huilu
response.text: Then have a seat! I assure you, you won't regret taking the time to stop and listen!

response.speaker: Huilu
response.text: And may we meet again! Should your heart ever hunger for stories, you know where to find me.

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: In with the mushrooms... and now some wild root veggies...

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: #The drink's all ready! Want to try some, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, did you say... "mushrooms"?

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: Sure did! All just ordinary ingredients and seasonings to help improve the flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: The stage is set, and ordinary drinks simply won't do justice to the music that's about to be served.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If you say so...

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry! You're hardly the first person to try this drink today. And the others are all perfectly fine!

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: See? They're already dancing by the stage, drinks in hand and all.

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: #Come on, {NICKNAME}! Grab a cup and let's get moving to the music!

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: Put your troubles aside and enjoy the music!

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: Oh, but don't get too carried away, especially when you're dancing. We don't want anybody getting injured out there!

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: Some folks danced themselves into a stupor earlier. Even when they were being carried away, they were mumbling something barely coherent...

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: "I can— I can see the hilichurls... They're dancing beside me..."

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: ...Anyway, I'm sure you get the picture. Get onstage and have some fun!

dialogues.speaker: Avisura
dialogues.text: #Okay, the drink's all ready... Oh hey, {NICKNAME}! You want some?

response.speaker: Avisura
response.text: Coming right up! Here you go, now join us on the dance floor!

choices.text: Oh, no thanks! I really shouldn't...

response.speaker: Avisura
response.text: That's too bad! But hey, if you change your mind, you know where to find me! Wait too long, and we might just run out completely!
